ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Admin email address (placeholder is fine — no SMTP configured)

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Admin password — auto-generated, min 8 chars. Copy from the Variables tab after deploy.

PUFFER_PANEL_REGISTRATIONENABLED.description: Allow public self-registration (false = invite-only via admin-created accounts)

PLAYIT_SECRET.description: Optional playit.gg agent secret for UDP game tunnels (Valheim/Rust/7DTD/CS2). Get it at playit.gg; port mappings are managed in the playit dashboard. Leave empty if you only host TCP games (e.g. Minecraft).
